items.title: Maple Winged Seed Pair
items.alt: A mature maple seed pair has two plump joined seed chambers and delicate tan veined wings spread apart.
items.description: A mature maple seed pair has two plump joined seed chambers and delicate tan veined wings spread apart. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Maple Samara Cluster
items.alt: A drooping cluster of green and rose tinged maple winged seed pairs hangs from a twig beneath two lobed leaves.
items.description: A drooping cluster of green and rose tinged maple winged seed pairs hangs from a twig beneath two lobed leaves. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Sprouting Maple Seed
items.alt: A single tan maple winged seed has a new ivory root emerging from its swollen seed chamber.
items.description: A single tan maple winged seed has a new ivory root emerging from its swollen seed chamber. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Maple Seedling and Roots
items.alt: A small maple seedling has two low narrow cotyledons and two lobed true leaves above a cutaway soil mound and branching roots, with a paired samara beside it.
items.description: A small maple seedling has two low narrow cotyledons and two lobed true leaves above a cutaway soil mound and branching roots, with a paired samara beside it. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Young Maple in a Nursery Pot
items.alt: A young maple sapling with a slender woody trunk and opposite pairs of green lobed leaves grows in a plain black nursery pot.
items.description: A young maple sapling with a slender woody trunk and opposite pairs of green lobed leaves grows in a plain black nursery pot. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Maple Tree in Autumn
items.alt: A complete mature maple tree has a broad rounded crown of orange, red and gold leaves above a small leaf strewn grass base.
